standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.npc: Welcome. Have you come to give your soul to the Chasm?

standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.player: Uh, I believe I'm still using it.

standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.npc: For now. Have you came to prove yourself in combat against the many demons within the Chasm?
My master prefers that his minions be killed with purpose.

standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.text: If the player has not completed A Kingdom Divided:

steps.npc: I ask no questions of my master, I just inform.

standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.text: If the player has completed A Kingdom Divided, but has not signed Yama's contract:

steps.npc: I am not worthy to explain on his behalf. Descend the Chasm and speak with him yourself if you wish for further details.

standard-dialogue-by-the-entrance-of-the.text: If the player has completed A Kingdom Divided and has signed Yama's contract:

steps.npc: As outlined in your contract, he wishes them slain in particular ways.

steps.player: Could you remind me what ways those were?

steps.npc: Death by two-handed melee weapons, heavy ranged weapons, magic spells, special attacks, and defeating them whilst bound.
Additionaly, he will request a specific method to be used. If you comply, your chances of obtaining a reward will be increased.

steps.text: If the player is currently required to kill a demon with a two-handed melee weapon:

steps.npc: Currently, my master wishes for you to use two handed melee weapons to kill his minions.

steps.text: If the player is currently required to kill a demon with a heavy ranged weapon:

steps.npc: Currently, my master wishes for you to use heavy ranged weapons to kill his minions.

steps.text: If the player is currently required to kill a demon with a magic spell:

steps.npc: Currently, my master wishes for you to use spells to kill his minions.
No.

steps.text: If the player is currently required to kill a demon with a special attack:

steps.npc: Currently, my master wishes for you to use special attacks to kill his minions.

steps.text: If the player is currently required to kill a demon while it is bound:

steps.player: What kinds of rewards would I receive?

steps.npc: Special contracts, to be presented to my master for further discussion.
You are most welcome.

standard-dialogue-inside-the-chasm-of-fi.npc: Oh yes! Just praying to my new master. It's hot down here, isn't it?

options.text: Your new master, that would be...?

steps.player: Your new master, that would be...?

steps.npc: Yama! I sold my soul you see, well, I guess that Ox-headed guy down there forcibly removed it.

steps.player: That doesn't sound like a fair trade...

steps.npc: Oh, don't worry, I'm perfectly fine with the outcome. Sure, the loss of vision is a shame but it could be worse.
Underground there are no tall buildings, I'm awfully afraid of heights, you see.

steps.player: Perhaps it's a good thing you can't see...

steps.npc: What was that?
The ritual, there were some... adverse effects...
Oh yes! Pretty basic really, head of an Ox, bruma roots, lots of fire and of course the human sacrifice.

steps.player: And at what point did that blind you?

steps.npc: The voice demanded that we stare into the fire until we saw enlightenment.

steps.player: I guess the fire was pretty bright.

steps.npc: Blindingly so.

steps.player: Wait! Did you say human sacrifice?

steps.npc: Why, of course! We're Zamorakians, we're evil...

options.text: Well, I'll leave you to it.

steps.player: Well, I'll leave you to it.

steps.npc: So soon?

steps.player: Yep, the demons won't slay themselves.

steps.npc: What demons?
